title: Design Doc
description: Google-style technical design: context, goals, non-goals, design, alternatives.

gates.message: Overview needs a short BLUF conclusion (≤120 words).
Goals and non-goals are both required.

agentPrompt: Fill data.json for a design-doc overview. Required: bluf (≤120 words), context, goals[], nonGoals[], design, alternatives[]. Write every string field in the user's language. Do not invent day1Commands or a fake completed state. Do not write canvas layout here — content only. Default presentation is decision_nav_4 (no Day-1 tab).
